template.name: Sangfor NGAF by SNMP
template.description: Sangfor NGAF monitoring via private SANGFOR-MIB (enterprises 35047), converted from the vendor MIB file SANGFOR-MIB.txt. Requires SNMP v2c or later (Counter64 objects). Verified against a live NGAF running AF8.0.108.657: sfIfInRate/sfIfOutRate are instantaneous byte/s gauges (x8 only); sfIfInPkts/sfIfOutPkts and drops are cumulative counters (change per second); memory counters are kB, disk counters MB.

item.name: Memory usage
item.description: sfSysMemoryUsage - device-reported usage % (returns a numeric string; regex-extracted). Free/total would give a different number because the device counts cache/buffer as available.

trigger.name: HA control link is ABNORMAL on {HOST.NAME}
HA data link is ABNORMAL on {HOST.NAME}

item.name: HA sync state
item.description: sfHASyncState: 0 - invalid, 1 - sync running, 2 - sync end, 3 - unknown

item.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: Inbound traffic
item.description: sfIfInRate - instantaneous byte/s (verified on AF 8.0.108), x8 -> bit/s

item.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: Outbound traffic
item.description: sfIfOutRate - instantaneous byte/s (verified on AF 8.0.108), x8 -> bit/s
